description_en: Copies a database between ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances
description_zh: 该接口用于在RDS SQL Server实例间复制数据库
kebab_example: aliyun rds copy-database-between-instances --db-instance-id rm-bp172446ys9cf0000 --target-db-instance-id rm-bp1m71wvzfiq70000 --db-names zhttest_:_zhttest --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyDatabaseBetweenInstances

parameters.help_en: The source instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The target instance ID. You can invoke DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: target_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of database names to be copied. Format: `{"Source database name":"Destination database name"}`. Separate multiple databases with commas (,). Examples:

Copy a single database: `{"zhttest":"zhttest"}`
Copy multiple databases: `{"zhttest01":"zhttest01","zhttest02":"zhttest02"}`

The database name on the target instance can be different from that on the source instance. However, make sure that the target instance does not contain a database with the same name before copying
parameters.help_zh:
待复制的数据库名称列表，格式如下：`{"源实例的数据库名称":"目标实例的数据库名称"}`。复制多个库时，用英文逗号（,）分隔。示例如下：

复制单个库：`{"zhttest":"zhttest"}`
复制多个库：`{"zhttest01":"zhttest01","zhttest02":"zhttest02"}`

目标实例的数据库名称可与源实例不同，但复制前需确保目标实例中不存在同名数据库
parameters.name: db_names

parameters.help_en:
The backup set ID of the source instance. To copy a database from a backup set, call DescribeBackups to query the backup set ID.
You must specify either BackupId or RestoreTime
parameters.help_zh:
源实例备份集ID。按备份集复制数据库时，可以通过查询备份列表接口DescribeBackups获取备份集ID。
调用接口时，BackupId和RestoreTime需传入任意一个
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to copy the database. You can specify any point in time within the backup retention period. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). You must specify either BackupId or RestoreTime
parameters.help_zh: 按时间点复制数据库，可以选择备份保留周期内的任意时间点。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 调用接口时，BackupId和RestoreTime需传入任意一个
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to copy users and permissions. Valid values:
YES: Users and permissions are copied. If the target instance contains a user with the same name, the permissions of the user on the source instance are merged with those of the user on the target instance.
NO (default): Users and permissions are not copied
parameters.help_zh:
是否复制用户和权限，取值：
YES：表示复制用户和权限。如果目标实例中有同名的用户，则该用户将叠加源实例的同名用户的权限。
NO（默认值）：表示不复制用户和权限
parameters.name: sync_user_privilege
